The '''Jedi monument''' was an old [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] temple on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] and the burial site of [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]].

==History==
{{Quote|Master, I'm sensing something strange.''"<br />"''Me too. Be careful Anakin, there are powerful forces guarding Ulic's tomb. They will not let you enter without a fight.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Game" />}}
[[File:Ulics_Tomb.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in the tomb of [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], inside the Jedi monument]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces [[Evacuation of Rhen Var|attacked]] and eliminated a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Bravo Base|outpost]] situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] to allow access to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] monument in search for information pertaining to the [[Dark Reaper]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] creation.<ref name="Game" />

During a [[Battle of Rhen Var (Clone Wars)|later engagement]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] led the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] to recapture the monument. Anakin penetrated the temple after the outer defenses were destroyed, and had to prove himself by defeating a trio of [[spectral guardian]]s. After the ordeal, Skywalker communicated with [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma's]] [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] and learned how to survive the effects of the Reaper.<ref name="Game" />
